facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, freely; the UAE has no currency restrictions.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: dirham or foreign-currency accounts, at home or abroad.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not researched yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Get a freelance permit from a free zone, or a mainland trade licence.
facts.L2_tax_id: The UAE doesn't issue TINs; you can apply for a tax residency certificate.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: No personal income tax; business income above AED 1m falls under 9% corporate tax.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 5% VAT above AED 375,000 a year; exported services are zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: PDPL (Decree-Law 45/2021) applies; its start date isn't confirmed.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online consumer protection law exists; refund rules not confirmed yet.
facts.L7_incentives: No personal income tax, and 0% corporate tax on the first AED 375,000 profit.

watch_out.text: Over AED 1m turnover you must register and file, even if tax is zero.
Zero-rated export sales count toward the AED 375,000 VAT threshold.
